messages:
Samira Khan: quick flag from renewal checkins  two customers asked for the same integrations flow and one said they might delay renewal if its not smoother. Need a fast capture format so PMs can triage within a minute.
Ethan Cole: ugh. can we do a 1-line ask + 1-line impact + tag? PMs get overloaded with prose. :grimacing:
Samira Khan: exactly. proposed one-line format below — paste into the customer note or thread reply.
```
OneLine Ask
- Ask: sync backend <-> analytics on import (1 line)
- Impact: blocks 2 pilot customers; slows onboarding by ~3 days each
- Urgency: high | Tags: integrations | onboarding | renewal-risk
```
Aisha Patel: love the simplicity. can we add a "workaround" field (one short sentence) so CSMs can help immediately?
Ethan Cole: +1. also add rough estimate: dev-days or complexity tag (low/med/high). helps PM queue.
Samira Khan: updated sample with workaround & complexity.
```
OneLine Ask
- Ask: sync backend <-> analytics on import
- Impact: 2 pilots, onboarding delay ~3 days
- Urgency: high | Complexity: med
- Workaround: manual CSV export once/day
- Tags: integrations | onboarding | renewal-risk
```
ProductOps Bot: Created quick intake doc: https://go.redwood.ai/cs/one-line-ask (private). Auto-exports rows labeled "renewal-risk" to the product triage board. :robot_face:
OnboardBot: Uploaded notes for NovaHealth onboarding. Recommended converts: lines 12 and 34 into OneLine Ask format.
Aisha Patel: plan: pilot 10 one-line asks over 2 weeks across onboarding + renewal outreach. target: at least 3 with quantifiable impact. weekly export to PM triage on Fridays.
Ethan Cole: i'll add "capture one one-line ask" to the renewal playbook checklist. small change, big upside.
Samira Khan: thanks team. goal is faster signal -> fewer surprises at renewal. i'll post a short pilot update next Friday. :rocket:
